content.short: The Royal Chess Club is the first (of a kind) Cardano Chess NFT project.
content.description:
This unique project comprises a dynamic collection of 450 chess sets with 7,200 NFTs on Cardano Blockchain Our art will feature 6 base characters that capture the 6 different types of chess pieces - King, Queen, Rook, Bishop, Knight, Pawn.

Collect all 16 pieces of a Chess NFT set to make your own set, or rent it out and be ready to battle with your opponent.
